description: US Conec MT (Mechanical Transfer) ferrules are precision multi-fiber PPS thermoplastic ferrules for 125 µm optical fiber. The family supports up to 72 fiber holes with 0.25 mm pitch and aligns fibers using two stainless-steel guide pins in precision-molded guide holes. They are used with MTP®/MPO connectivity and can also be integrated into custom passive or active optical coupling packages; the family is compliant with IEC 61754-5.

__characteristics__.name: MT Ferrules
__characteristics__.description: Precision PPS-based multi-fiber ferrules used in MTP®/MPO assemblies and custom optical coupling. US Conec emphasizes high molding precision, low-hygroscopic material for environmental stability, and MT Elite® low-loss grades; single-mode pre-angled and multimode optimized variants are available.

specs.Performance Grade: Standard / MT Elite® / Super MT Elite®
specs.Fiber Count Options: Up to 72 fiber holes; common 1×12 / 1×16 / 2×12 / 4×12 / 6×12 formats
specs.Material: Composite PPS thermoplastic; extremely low hygroscopic material
specs.Alignment: Two stainless-steel guide pins in precision-molded alignment holes
specs.Polish / Endface: SM angled protruded / pre-angled options; MM flat protruded options
specs.Return Loss: MT Elite published family: SM PA ≥60 dB; MM ≥25 dB
